articles.image_title: Afghanistan: This photograph taken on January 8, 2026 shows an Afghan nurse (R) attending children inside the Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) malnutrition ward at a hospital in Herat. In the country of more than 40 million people, there are relatively few medical centres that can help treat malnutrition. Some families travel hundreds of kilometres (miles) to reach Herat hospital as they lack healthcare facilities in their home provinces. (Photo by Wakil KOHSAR / AFP via Getty Images) / To go with 'Afghanistan-Malnutrition-Children' , FOCUS

articles.title: Crans-Montana: Barbesitzer von Crans-Montana wegen häuslicher Gewalt festgenommen
articles.teaser: Berichten zufolge sitzt einer der Barbesitzer des Crans-Montana-Brandes wegen häuslicher Gewalt in Untersuchungshaft. Demnach wurde er bereits vor Tagen festgenommen.
articles.image_title: Crans-Montana: Co-owner of Le Constellation bar Jacques Moretti arrives to attend a hearing as part of the inquiry into a devastating New Year's fire in Sion on June 5, 2026. The French couple Jacques and Jessica Moretti were to be cross-examined by public prosecutors and lawyers for civil parties caught up in the blaze that engulfed Le Constellation bar in Crans-Montana in the early hours of January 1, 2026. The tragedy killed 41 people, mostly teenagers, and injured 115 others. (Photo by Fabrice COFFRINI / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Westafrika: Mindestens 30 Tote nach Erdrutsch an Mülldeponie in Guinea
articles.teaser: Ein Müllberg hat nach starkem Regen eine Siedlung am Rand von Guineas Hauptstadt verschüttet. Mindestens 30 Menschen starben, 22 weitere wurden verletzt.
articles.image_title: Westafrika: Residents and rescuers use an excavator to search for bodies after a landslide struck the Dar es Salaam dumpsite overnight in Conakry on August 23, 2026. Thirty people died and six were seriously wounded Sunday on the outskirts of Conakry, Guinea's capital, after a mound of rubbish in a landfill collapsed onto homes following heavy rains, said a government statement.The accident happened at 2:00 am (0200 GMT) Sunday morning, at the Dar-es-salam neighbourhood in the Bbessia district, said the government statement. (Photo by AFP via Getty Images)
